Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

As a Talent Acquisition Operations Associate, reporting to the Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition and Operations, you will help run the operations behind Payward’s global hiring engine. You will support the systems, processes, and coordination that keep hiring moving at pace, from interview operations and executive hiring to pre-boarding, background checks, and new hire setup in Workday. This role extends well beyond scheduling. It requires a strategic view of how a fast-growing, global company hires, along with precision, discretion, and sound judgment.

You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and executive assistants to support scheduling, anticipate bottlenecks, and keep stakeholders aligned at every stage. You will work heavily in our recruiting tools, keeping candidate and hiring data accurate and up to date across regions.

This is a 6-month fixed-term position supporting US timezones.

The opportunity

  • Own interview operations end to end, partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates across regions and time zones to deliver a seamless candidate experience

  • Support global executive and non-executive hiring operations, including scheduling and rescheduling, tracking and candidate communications

  • Partner with executive assistants across regions to coordinate calendars and keep hiring timelines on track

  • Own pre-boarding for new hires worldwide, including country-specific background check requirements and communications, tracking progress, resolving issues, and flagging risks to start dates early

  • Create and maintain accurate candidate and hiring records in Ashby and Workday, and ensure new hire data is complete and timely for hires in every region

  • Partner with onboarding, recruiting, and hiring managers to create a seamless transition from offer acceptance to day one

  • Apply our hiring policies accurately and consistently across regions, flagging exceptions and escalating early

What you bring

  • 4+ years in recruiting coordination, talent acquisition operations, HR operations, or a similar role, ideally in a high-growth, global environment spanning NORAM, EMEA, LATAM, APAC and MENA

  • Hands-on experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS, and familiarity with applicant tracking systems (Ashby a plus)

  • Experience supporting pre-boarding and onboarding, including coordinating background checks, tracking progress, resolving issues, and flagging risks to start dates early

  • Working knowledge of background check processes and requirements across multiple countries and regions

  • Comfort coordinating across time zones, with the ability to manage complex, high-volume calendars and logistics with exceptional precision and no missed details

  • Exceptional judgment and discretion in handling confidential candidate and executive information

  • Excellent communication skills and the professionalism to work comfortably with executives, hiring managers, and candidates from diverse regions and cultures

  • The ability to prioritize competing deadlines and adapt quickly

Nice to have

  • Experience in crypto, fintech, or another regulated industry

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
About the role
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Finance Specialist to join our team and report directly to the Finance Manager. You will help keep our finance operations accurate, timely and well controlled, with a focus on financial close, payments, staff expense claims, tax compliance and audit support.
This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working through the details, resolving discrepancies and taking ownership of recurring finance processes. You will work with colleagues across the business and external advisers, while also supporting selected financial and regulatory reporting activities as the team grows.
 
What you’ll do
Financial close and accounting
  • Support monthly, quarterly and annual close activities, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, account reconciliations and balance-sheet schedules.
  • Reconcile bank accounts, payment activity, vendor balances and other assigned accounts; investigate differences and follow through to resolution.
  • Analyse account movements and unusual transactions, prepare supporting explanations, and escalate matters requiring accounting judgment.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and complete close tasks in line with agreed timelines and review procedures.
  • Perform trade and wallet reconciliations as part of the month-end close, comparing trade-level raw data from the Big Data platform with records in NetSuite (NS), reconciling wallet activity and balances, and investigating and resolving any discrepancies with relevant teams.
 
Payments and staff claims
  • Review payment requests, invoices and supporting documentation for accuracy, completeness and compliance with company policies.
  • Prepare and coordinate payments through established approval workflows, maintaining appropriate controls and segregation of duties.
  • Track payment status, resolve rejected or delayed payments, and respond to queries from internal teams and external parties.
  • Review and process staff expense claims, including checking receipts, policy compliance, approvals and correct accounting treatment.
  • Reconcile payments and expense reimbursements to bank statements and accounting records, and follow up on outstanding items.
 
Tax, regulatory reporting and audit support
  • Prepare VAT reconciliations, return schedules and supporting documentation, working with the Finance Manager and external tax advisers as needed.
  • Assist with the preparation of corporate tax returns, including gathering financial data, preparing supporting schedules, reconciling tax-related balances and responding to adviser queries.
  • Flag uncertain or unusual tax treatments for review and help track applicable filing deadlines.
  • Assist with selected financial and regulatory reporting activities, including data gathering, reconciliations, completeness checks and preparation of supporting schedules. The Finance Manager will review reporting outputs and matters requiring judgment before submission.
  • Support statutory audits and other internal or external reviews by preparing schedules, gathering evidence, responding to information requests and tracking outstanding items.
  • Maintain organised documentation and clear audit trails across accounting, payments, tax and reporting activities.
 
Process improvement and collaboration
  • Partner with Finance, Operations and other teams to resolve accounting, invoice, payment and expense-claim issues.
  • Identify recurring issues or manual steps and suggest practical improvements to workflows, controls and documentation.
  • Support finance process or system changes, including testing and documenting their impact on day-to-day operations.
 
What we’re looking for
  • A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of relevant accounting or finance experience, including hands-on involvement in financial close and reconciliations.
  • Experience with payment processing, staff expense claims and approval workflows.
  • Practical exposure to VAT, corporate tax compliance or preparation of tax return supporting schedules.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Excel and experience using an accounting or ERP system.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • A proactive approach to resolving issues, with the judgment to know when to escalate.
 
Nice to have
  • Experience in crypto, digital assets, fintech or financial services, particularly in an international or fast-growing business.
  • Experience assisting with regulatory reporting or maintaining supporting evidence for regulatory submissions.
  • Experience working with external auditors and tax advisers.
  • Exposure to multi-entity accounting, cross-border payments or finance process automation.
  • Progress towards an accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CA or an equivalent.
  • Professional working proficiency in Mandarin.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

UP (Unified Platform) consolidates data and technologies into a comprehensive solution, accelerating time to market. Optimizing decision-making and research, our platform simplifies implementing new ideas, enhancing our competitive edge. We work from high-level requirements where programmers are expected to gain an intimate understanding of the business. We strive for an environment where developers have the autonomy to pursue business solutions without arbitrary management constraints. We are a group of polyglots and technologists always seeking to find the right tool for each problem. Broadly, the development teams at DRW believe in rapid deployment and feedback, automated testing, and cohesive, transparent, lightly coupled service architectures. 

The Pricing and Derived Data team within UP is seeking an outstanding Senior Software Engineer to join us in building a new data platform that provides intra-day and end-of-day prices across the firm.

The team is responsible for pricing millions of instruments across many asset classes and exchanges in near-real-time. Clients range from trading systems needing low-latency updates to researchers working with large historical datasets.

Our current architecture is written mostly in Elixir, which we enjoy and derive great value from. Inter-service streaming communication is over gRPC and the data layer comprises PostgreSQL, Kafka, and ClickHouse. Demand for our services is growing rapidly across a variety of access patterns, and we are now building a comprehensive data platform as an extension of our existing system to meet this demand.

This position presents an opportunity to shape the future direction of our work. The successful candidate will play a key role in answering questions such as:

  • How do we guarantee that a client sees the same prices whether they query the warehouse, subscribe to a stream, or call our gRPC API?
  • How do we let clients load a snapshot and then switch to live updates with no gaps or duplicates?
  • What parts of our systems should stay in Elixir, and where should we consider other technologies?

Experience

We are looking for strong senior generalists who have a considerable experience building data products.

Candidates should be able to provide examples of significant projects that they have led from design through to operating in production, including responsibility for architectural decisions. We are interested in hearing from candidates who have had to choose between technologies and can talk to us about why they would or would not make that choice again.

Relevant areas include event streaming, change data capture, open table formats and stream and batch processing. Associated technologies include Kafka, Delta Lake, Iceberg, ClickHouse, Spark, and Flink. We are interested in a deep understanding of the architectural requirements that these technologies are suitable for rather than years of experience in a specific one of them.

Prior experience in Elixir or in the financial domain is not required, but candidates should be interested in working in these areas.

Examples of projects you may have led include:

  • Designing and building a high-volume and/or low-latency data processing system, including ingestion, storage, and distribution.
  • Scaling an ingestion pipeline handling thousands, or tens of thousands of events per second on a single node (optimisation) and/or across multiple nodes (distribution).
  • The operation and support of a data product which has time- and correctness-sensitive delivery requirements.

Personal traits

We value:

  • Humility and respect for others, and trust in our teammates.
  • The ability to learn, adapt and grow.
  • The capacity to independently drive projects to completion, but a preference to collaborate with teammates.
  • Excellent listening and communication skills

The annual base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the gross domestic product of the internet.

About the team

The Platform Sales team works with business-to-business software platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using Stripe Connect. Software platforms are businesses that build payments and financial services into their products. Platforms that use Stripe include Shopify, Xero, me&u, and Ignition.

You will help customers understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses. You have worked with upper middle market and enterprise accounts, understand the buyer journey, and can lead complex, consultative sales processes involving multiple stakeholders.

We are looking for a Senior Associate/ Director in Trading Desk Operations to join our Trading Team. You will help on the operational side of the trading desk, supporting trading and funding operations and streamlining processes to support the growth of our Trading business. You will gain an in-depth understanding of the trade life cycle for the particular trading desk you will support.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide dedicated end-to-end trade support to assigned trading desks, perform trade bookings, trade verifications, balance and position reconciliations, P&L attributions

  • Troubleshoot operational bottlenecks, delays, and other problems presented throughout the trade life cycle

  • Using coding and AI tools, develop and enhance booking and reconciliation procedures

  • Real-time monitoring and escalation on risk positions against internal thresholds and develop new monitoring tools for the desk

  • Develop standardized templates and playbooks for new product onboarding (booking models, reconciliation rules, account setup) to reduce time-to-market

  • Set up of new accounts and trading books, maintain data integrity and data mapping

  • Perform funding operations and settlement checks, investigate and resolve fund transfer issues, liaising internally with Treasury or with external brokers

  • Monitor funding usage, ROI and manage internal capital distribution records

  • Assist in analysis of trading performance, P&L and risk attribution

  • Assist promptly in adhoc/urgent requests from the trading desks relating to trade bookings or funding requests

  • Engage with developers on projects that further enhance system infrastructure and controls

  • Identify repetitive manual processes across the trade lifecycle and build automated solutions (scripts, macros, RPA) to reduce operational risk and processing time

Requirements:

  • Degree holder in Finance/Accounting or Quantitative discipline

  • 5+ years of working experience on the Trading floor as Trading Assistant or Trade Support or in relevant functions such as Middle Office, Product Control in a financial services or crypto trading firm

  • Have working knowledge in AI tools and Python and an interest to expand your technical skills

  • Excellent problem solving skills, detailed oriented mindset with a high degree of accuracy

  • Positive and proactive, critical thinker who strives for continuous improvement

  • A product owner, results oriented, think outside of the box and can deliver under pressure

  • Thrive to work in a dynamic environment, passionate about cryptocurrency and blockchain
